question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**We**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a situation involving movement and ascending through a dark and eerie landscape.
 
• The appropriate pronoun should reflect the speaker's perspective, as they are part of the action being described in the sentence.
 
• We" is the correct choice as it fits the context of the narrator being part of the group experiencing the situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• I (मैं): "I" refers to the speaker alone, which does not match the context of a group movement.
 
• They (वे): "They" would imply someone else, not the speaker, making it an incorrect choice in this context.
 
• Us (हमें): "Us" would also be incorrect, as it is a subjective form and not fitting for the subject's action in the sentence.
